Package com.egradx.auth.web

Class EgradxSignInController

java.lang.Object
com.egradx.auth.web.EgradxSignInController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/egradx/auth") public class EgradxSignInController extends Object
Signing up, and signing in without a password: by an emailed code or an OpenID Connect provider (docs/auth/sign-in-methods.md). Every endpoint here is public.
